comment: Many people warned me that she is a tougher grader, but if you put the time/effort in then there is no worries about exams. She is always accessible outside of class and though email. Her class has great lectures and is very interactive and hands on with materials. Her class/exams tests your application abilities rather than memorization. The best!

I had her for both 199 and 200 lab. She can be a vague and unhelpful with grading and explaining certain topics/confusions. Her lectures can be extremely repetitive and lengthy at times, and she has a tendency to speak to students like we are in middle school. Overall, she was okay and taught class material. She is a tough grader.

I try not to judge professors based off of classes like bio 200, where they are forced to teach the same material for consistency sake, but I had Hilliker for 200 lab and I think it is useful to know about the lab professor too. Definitely intense but if you put the work in and show you care she will too. Expect an intensive but fun lab time.

She is not very organized and its hard to figure out what she expects and what we get graded on. However, she is very smart. She is a tough grader. You will be frustrated in this class if you like structure and organization because it is confusing and frustrating to understand what is expected of you

Overall, the class was fine, but I did not learn much. The most frustrating part of the course was that she talked down to students and acted as though we had no previous knowledge. A lot of the class was a review of AP biology classes, but whenever we would contribute in class she would say it was not correct then slightly reword what was said.

I've only interacted with her on a research basis, and not in the classroom, but she's extremely helpful. She's very busy, so don't expect help whenever you need it, but if you have the time, she will meet with you. She will point you in the right direction, but you have to get to the answer yourself. She's a great person, but expect to work.

Dr. Hilliker was always available when I needed to ask her questions or clarify material. She's very approachable and willing to help her students. She challenged me to figure out the answers to my own questions. She is a fair grader and her tests are fair as well.

Dr. Hilliker is a great professor!  Genetics itself is a difficult course, regardless of the professor (I have yet to hear from any of my friends a "good" professor for genetics).  That being said, the course is difficult, but Dr. Hilliker is very fair and she wants her students to succeed.  She's very nice and approachable - I'd recommend her!

New and engaging professor.  She was a tough grader and the class was an overall difficult course.  When going for help, she helped somewhat but made me figure out most of my questions on my own.  She was a very nice person and I feel like she will get better in future years as a professor.

Molecular Genetics was not an easy class, by any means, but I really enjoyed it. Dr. Hilliker is a really good teacher, and a great person. She clearly puts in so much effort and cares very much for her students. I learned a ton, and would definitely recommend her to others!

Easily the hardest class of my college career, but also the meatiest. Dense paper discussions due every two weeks, non-stop technical lab work and writeups etc... She does go above and beyond in terms of helpfulness. This would be a bad fit for someone just trying to get their ticket punched. Also, best value but really really hard.
